subject: [PATCH 2/2] scsi: mpi3mr: Stop IRQ polling when no reply is ready

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch modifies the MPI3MR SCSI driver to stop IRQ polling when no reply is ready on a queue, reducing CPU usage and improving performance. The driver previously polled queues for about 45 seconds, waking every ~20us, which was inefficient. The change introduces an empty check while owning the queue, allowing the driver to switch back to interrupts once a poll finds the queue empty. This approach reduces the number of wakeups from 236 times per I/O to twice per I/O, resulting in significant CPU savings and improved throughput for certain workloads.
